links.outcome: Medical QA accuracy and answer similarity with verified retrieval versus baseline LLM
links.effect: Accuracy improved from 41.3% to 48.8% on MedQA; BERTScore rose from 68.1% to 74.4% on MedicationQA using LLaMA-3.
links.quote: For instance, CRITIC-RAG improves accuracy from 41.3% to 48.8% on MedQA and boosts BERTScore from 68.1% to 74.4% on MedicationQA using LLaMA-3.

unlisted_practices: small instruction-tuned verifier integrated throughout the RAG pipeline

screen.reason: Evaluates a modular verification framework (selective retrieval, evidence filtering, and groundedness verification) integrated with existing LLMs to improve factual reliability on medical benchmarks.

primary.practice: retrieval verification and evidence filtering guardrails
